referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The dataset represents a global IP traffic and the amount of data centres globally. Global IP traffic is based on Cisco 2018 CGI, representing 4.4 ZB data in 2020. The total amount of data centres globally is based on the assumption that globally, data centres consume 340 TWh (source: IEA 2022 Data Centres). This total amount is then divided by the average electricity consumption of a single data centre. The average electricity consumption of a data centre assumes a 24/7 operation for 365 days and a data centre power intensity of 6646 W / m2. The data centre power intensity assumes a power usage effectiveness (PUE) of 2. It is based on the IT area per IT power from Siddik et al 2021 and is weighted based on IT area of different data centre types (e.g., hyperscale, small, etc) from Shehabi et al 2021. The large number of data centres seems plausible since small data centres are included in the assumption. The input of the total number of data centres already considers the lifetime of each data centre element, for example servers, network equipment, and storage equipment (HDD and SSD). The functional unit = 1 GB.
